hardware: 4x NVIDIA H20 (78 SM, sm_90a), EP4, single node (gpu-node), GPUs acquired with gpulock -n 4
kernel: SM90 fused FP8 MegaMoE, zero inter-operator grid_sync (GEMM1->GEMM2 K-block bitmap, grid-free Notify->Pull, ready-gated Scatter->Combine)
harness_models_note: the harness defines exactly 3 models (q35b, q122b, qwen38max); no other benchmark model exists in it, so only these 3 were measured

arms.ngs_auto_dw8: this work, WEAVE_CU_WAVE_SPLIT unset (auto Lag-W), WEAVE_DISPATCH_WARPS=8, REDUCE_WARPS=0, comm_only+smem
arms.ngs_auto_dw4: this work, auto Lag-W, default dispatch warps (4), REDUCE_WARPS=0, comm_only+smem
arms.champ_rw0: V13 champion (grid_sync GEMM1->GEMM2 + BeforeCombine NVLink barrier), DW=8, REDUCE_WARPS=0
arms.v13_adapt1_dw4: V13 champion engine with default dispatch warps (4)

accuracy_summary.gate: calc_diff < 1e-3 vs FP32 reference on every rank, full tensor; nonfinite == 0; recv stats exact; 500 back-to-back + 500 per-launch checked + 100 alternating-route launches

timing_method: per process: warmup 2 + 2 palindromic ABBA rounds of synchronized 4-rank launches, CUDA events, max over ranks per launch; processes ordered A1(ngs tree) B1(V13 tree) B2 A2; medians pooled over the two processes of each tree; official runs in both trees and is pooled for speedups
